title.why: Order No. 21 promulgation clause names 《人工智能拟人化互动服务管理暂行办法》; English rendering accurate ('Anthropomorphic AI Interaction Services').

original_title.why: Character-by-character match with the stored CAC page.

issuing_body.why: Five issuing bodies in the Order heading.

official_identifier.why: 令 第21号 in the Order heading; the Gazette headnote repeats 令第21号.

status.why: In force since 15 Jul 2026; nothing later found.

legal_force.why: Art. 30 sets warnings, orders and fines.

summary_claims.claim: Bans virtual relative/partner (虚拟亲属、虚拟伴侣等虚拟亲密关系) services for minors; guardian consent for under-14s; minor mode (Art. 14)
Reminder after every 2 hours of continuous use; disclose that users deal with AI, not a natural person (Art. 18)
Security assessment at launch or new feature, major change from new technology, 1 million registered or 100,000 monthly active users (Art. 22(1)-(3))
No training on users' sensitive personal information in interaction data without separate consent unless law provides otherwise (Art. 16, last para.)
Fines RMB 10,000-100,000, or 100,000-200,000 where life or health is endangered with harmful consequences (Art. 30); AI sandbox platform (Art. 28); algorithm filing (Art. 26)

note: All fields supported by the stored CAC page; the State Council Gazette copy matches. Literal check of defined terms: 拟人化互动服务 = services that simulate a natural person's personality traits, thinking patterns and communication style to give continuing emotional interaction (Art. 2), as the summary says. The drafted summary and notes carry no unsupported claim; the removed 27 Dec 2025 draft date was rightly dropped. english_version is not set: the stored China Law Translate page holds Chinese text and its English link is not stored, so no kind with a stored URL can be recorded yet (the evidence script's warning). One targeted search found no amendment.
